simple.meaning: פַּעַם (paʻam) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a stroke , literally or figuratively (in various applications, as follow).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 118 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 11 more, beginning at Genesis 2:23. Its contexts include birth, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּעַם (H6471).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פַּעַם (paʻam) / H6471 is traced through Genesis 2:23, Genesis 18:32, Genesis 27:36, Genesis 29:34 as a generated source-based concept entry.
